title: Senate approves Supreme Court judge for audit panel
desc: The Senate approved Supreme Court judge Kajondej Janwattananon as a member of the State Audit Commission (SAC) in a 143-0 vote.
title_cn: 参议院全票通过最高法院法官加入审计委员会
summary_cn: 泰国参议院以143票全票赞成，批准最高法院法官Kajondej Janwattananon成为国家审计委员会成员。
desc_original: The Senate approved Supreme Court judge Kajondej Janwattananon as a member of the State Audit Commission (SAC) in a 143-0 vote.

title: Sophon says censure will go ahead
desc: House Speaker Sophon Zarum said a no-confidence debate would take place before the current parliamentary session ends, but the government and opposition remain at odds over the schedule.
title_cn: 众议院议长确认不信任投票将如期进行
summary_cn: 众议院议长Sophon Zarum表示针对政府的不信任投票辩论将在本会期结束前进行。但政府与反对党在投票日程安排上仍存分歧。
desc_original: House Speaker Sophon Zarum said a no-confidence debate would take place before the current parliamentary session ends, but the government and opposition remain at odds over the schedule.

title: NBTC legal woes threaten conference, flood relief
desc: Legal uncertainty over the status of the National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) chairman is threatening to affect preparations to attend a key international telecom conference and planned flood-relief measures for affected mobile phone subscribers, according to an NBTC executive source.
title_cn: NBTC主席身份法律困境威胁国际会议与灾救计划
summary_cn: 泰国国家广播电信委员会主席身份的法律不确定性，可能影响该委参加国际电信会议的筹备及向受灾手机用户提供救援措施的实施。
desc_original: Legal uncertainty over the status of the National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) chairman is threatening to affect preparations to attend a key international telecom conference and planned flood-relief measures for affected mobile phone subscribers, according to an NBTC executive source.

title: Royals set to  see requiem  performance
desc: Their Majesties the King and Queen will preside over and attend the premiere of "A Royal Requiem: Music in Memory and Prayers" on Nov 18 at Assumption Cathedral in Bangkok, an event organised by the Apostolic Nunciature of the Holy See in Thailand and the Catholic Bishops' Conference of Thailand (CBCT).
title_cn: 泰国王室出席「皇家安魂曲」音乐演出首演
summary_cn: 泰国国王和王后将于11月18日在曼谷圣母升天大教堂主持并出席「皇家安魂曲：纪念与祈祷之音乐」首演，该活动由梵蒂冈常任代表处与泰国天主教主教团共同主办。
desc_original: Their Majesties the King and Queen will preside over and attend the premiere of "A Royal Requiem: Music in Memory and Prayers" on Nov 18 at Assumption Cathedral in Bangkok, an event organised by the Apostolic Nunciature of the Holy See in Thailand and the Catholic Bishops' Conference of Thailand (CBCT).

title: PM says airport rail link contract remains binding
desc: The high-speed rail link connecting three airports must proceed under the existing contract, and any unresolved disputes would face legal proceedings, Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul said on Monday.
title_cn: 总理重申机场铁路连接合同约束力
summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷周一重申，连接三个机场的高速铁路链接必须按现有合同继续推进。他指出，任何未解决的合同争议将面临法律诉讼程序，强调该项目的约束力。
desc_original: The high-speed rail link connecting three airports must proceed under the existing contract, and any unresolved disputes would face legal proceedings, Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul said on Monday.

title: Trade and peace top talks agenda
desc: Malaysian Foreign Minister Dato' Seri Utama Haji Mohamad bin Haji Hasan begins a two-day visit to Thailand on Tuesday for talks on bilateral cooperation, security and border development.
title_cn: 贸易与和平成泰马会谈重点
summary_cn: 马来西亚外交部长哈山于周二开始对泰国进行为期两天的访问，就双边合作、安保与边界发展等议题举行对话，旨在深化两国在贸易、安全等领域的合作。
desc_original: Malaysian Foreign Minister Dato' Seri Utama Haji Mohamad bin Haji Hasan begins a two-day visit to Thailand on Tuesday for talks on bilateral cooperation, security and border development.

title: Ministry faces shortage  of doctor posts by 2029
desc: The Public Health Ministry could run out of civil-service doctor posts by 2029, leaving a projected 5,442 new doctors without such positions by 2040 unless the staffing ceiling is expanded, a Mahidol University study has found.
title_cn: 卫生部医生职位将面临短缺
summary_cn: 玛希隆大学研究表明，泰国卫生部公职医生岗位将于2029年前面临枯竭。若不扩展编制上限，估计到2040年将有约5442名新医科毕业生无位可得，对医疗服务供给构成长期压力。
desc_original: The Public Health Ministry could run out of civil-service doctor posts by 2029, leaving a projected 5,442 new doctors without such positions by 2040 unless the staffing ceiling is expanded, a Mahidol University study has found.

title: Anutin eases fears over holy basil rights protection
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has assured the public that protection rights for four varieties of holy basil will not prevent people from growing the herb for consumption or sale.
title_cn: 总理澄清圣罗勒保护权不影响民众种植销售
summary_cn: 总理阿努廷澄清，四个圣罗勒品种的知识产权保护政策不会阻止民众用于个人消费或商业销售，以此消除公众对该政策的疑虑，保护农民和市场的合法权益。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has assured the public that protection rights for four varieties of holy basil will not prevent people from growing the herb for consumption or sale.

title: Thailand ushers in a new era of digital finance and investment
desc: Thailand is moving towards a new era of digital finance, with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) and the Bank of Thailand working in tandem to develop digital securities, baht-backed stablecoins and new investment products that could make financial transactions more efficient and broaden access to capital markets.
title_cn: 泰国开启数字金融和投资新时代
summary_cn: 泰国证券交易委员会和泰央行携手开发数字证券、泰铢稳定币和新投资产品，推进金融数字化转型，提高交易效率并拓宽资本市场准入。
desc_original: Thailand is moving towards a new era of digital finance, with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) and the Bank of Thailand working in tandem to develop digital securities, baht-backed stablecoins and new investment products that could make financial transactions more efficient and broaden access to capital markets.

title: Office projects exports to expand by 15-16% in 2026
desc: Exports are projected to grow by 15-16% in 2026, following stronger-than-expected growth in the first nine months, driven by demand for electronics and investment in artificial intelligence infrastructure, according to the Trade Policy and Strategy Office (TPSO) under the Commerce Ministry.
title_cn: 泰国出口有望2026年增长15-16%
summary_cn: 泰国商务部贸易政策与战略办公室预计，2026年出口增长将达15-16%，延续前九个月超预期增长势头。增长动力主要来自电子产品需求旺盛和人工智能基础设施投资增加。
desc_original: Exports are projected to grow by 15-16% in 2026, following stronger-than-expected growth in the first nine months, driven by demand for electronics and investment in artificial intelligence infrastructure, according to the Trade Policy and Strategy Office (TPSO) under the Commerce Ministry.

title: Thaksin amnesty petition awaits review
desc: Justice permanent secretary Piyasiri Wattanawarangkun said a subcommittee he chairs had yet to receive former prime minister Thaksin Shinawatra's request for amnesty in political cases.
title_cn: 他信大赦申请待审查
summary_cn: 泰国司法常务次长皮亚西里表示，其主持的小委员会尚未收到前总理他信·西那瓦关于政治案件的赦免申请。这反映出他信赦免程序仍在早期阶段，后续审查需逐步推进。
desc_original: Justice permanent secretary Piyasiri Wattanawarangkun said a subcommittee he chairs had yet to receive former prime minister Thaksin Shinawatra's request for amnesty in political cases.

title: BMA seeks over B1bn in extra relief
desc: Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) plans to seek more than 1 billion baht in additional flood relief funding and has ordered district chiefs to draw up a new flood risk map following the capital's recent inundation.
title_cn: 曼谷市政府申请超10亿泰铢洪灾补助
summary_cn: 曼谷市政府计划申请超过10亿泰铢的额外洪灾救助资金，并要求各区长编制新的洪水风险地图。此举是针对首都近期严重水灾的应对措施，将帮助受灾地区恢复。
desc_original: Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) plans to seek more than 1 billion baht in additional flood relief funding and has ordered district chiefs to draw up a new flood risk map following the capital's recent inundation.

title: Call for political stability in Thailand to boost growth
desc: Greater political stability would support Thailand's economic growth and help the country maintain its sovereign credit rating over the longer term, according to S&P Global Ratings.
title_cn: 政治稳定有助泰国经济增长与信用评级
summary_cn: 标普全球评级公司表示，更强的政治稳定性将支持泰国经济增长，并帮助该国长期维持主权信用评级。政治稳定对吸引外资、维持投资者信心至关重要。
desc_original: Greater political stability would support Thailand's economic growth and help the country maintain its sovereign credit rating over the longer term, according to S&P Global Ratings.

title: i-Tail acquires Phelps Pet Products for $160m
desc: SET-listed i-Tail Corporation Public Co Ltd (ITC), a global pet food manufacturer, has completed its acquisition of Phelps Industries LLC, commonly known as Phelps Pet Products, for an enterprise value of US$160 million.
title_cn: 泰国i-Tail集团以1.6亿美元收购Phelps宠物食品公司
summary_cn: 泰国证交所上市公司i-Tail宠物食品集团完成对美国Phelps宠物食品公司的收购，交易价值1.6亿美元。此项并购是泰国宠物食品企业的重要国际扩张举措，有助拓展全球市场版图。
desc_original: SET-listed i-Tail Corporation Public Co Ltd (ITC), a global pet food manufacturer, has completed its acquisition of Phelps Industries LLC, commonly known as Phelps Pet Products, for an enterprise value of US$160 million.

title: Gulf CFO resigns amid talk of move into banking
desc: Yupapin Wangviwat has resigned as chief financial officer of Gulf Development Plc, Thailand's largest private power producer by market value, to take up a role in the banking sector.
title_cn: Gulf 电力首席财务官尤帕平辞职进军银行业
summary_cn: 泰国最大私人电力生产商 Gulf 电力开发公司（Gulf Development Plc）首席财务官尤帕平·王维瓦特（Yupapin Wangviwat）宣布辞职，将转向银行业发展。
desc_original: Yupapin Wangviwat has resigned as chief financial officer of Gulf Development Plc, Thailand's largest private power producer by market value, to take up a role in the banking sector.

title: Medical AI startups get boost in push for commercialisation
desc: Thailand is pushing 44 medical AI startups towards commercialisation by connecting developers with hospitals, investors and international partners, supporting its S-curve ambitions to build a higher-value life sciences industry.
title_cn: 泰国推动44家医疗人工智能初创企业商业化
summary_cn: 泰国正在推动44家医疗人工智能初创企业的商业化，通过连接开发者与医院、投资者及国际合作伙伴。此举旨在支持泰国「S曲线」战略，建立更高价值的生命科学产业。
desc_original: Thailand is pushing 44 medical AI startups towards commercialisation by connecting developers with hospitals, investors and international partners, supporting its S-curve ambitions to build a higher-value life sciences industry.

title: Slow visa processing disrupts travel to Thailand
desc: Slow visa processing in countries whose visa-free privileges have been withdrawn has disrupted travel to Thailand, with many travellers opting for Vietnam instead. Airlines have also reported a large number of no-show passengers and urged the government to resolve the issue as soon as possible.
title_cn: 签证办理延缓冲击赴泰旅游，旅客改向越南
summary_cn: 部分国家签证免除权被取消后，签证办理延缓导致赴泰旅游受阻。许多游客改为选择越南，航空公司报告出现大量旅客缺席情况，并敦促政府尽快解决此问题。
desc_original: Slow visa processing in countries whose visa-free privileges have been withdrawn has disrupted travel to Thailand, with many travellers opting for Vietnam instead. Airlines have also reported a large number of no-show passengers and urged the government to resolve the issue as soon as possible.

title: Foreign investment in Thai stocks set to rebound
desc: Foreign investors are expected to return to Thai equities despite elevated US bond yields, supported by improving corporate earnings and continued investment in artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure, says Bualuang Securities (BLS).
title_cn: 外资有望重返泰国股市

desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰媒报道，10月26日，泰国投资促进委员会（BOI）秘书长纳立表示，在地缘政治压力和技术发展推动全球投资格局调整的背景下，泰国投资促进申请金额持续增长，主要动力来自数字产业、电子产业以及农业和食品产业。 2026年1月至9月，泰国共收到1954个投资促进申请项目，申请投资总额达17074.3亿泰铢，同比增长28%。这一增长反映出投资向泰国转移的势头，以及投资者对泰国改善监管制度、完善基础设施和加快投资审批机制的信心。泰国政府推出的“Thailand FastPass”投资加速机制，以及面向未来产业人才培养的“Skill Bridge”措施，也为投资增长提供了支持。 其中，数字产业投资促进申请金额最高，超过11700亿泰铢，涉及139个项目，较去年同期接近翻倍。其次是电子及电器产业，申请金额为1893.7亿泰铢，涉及262个项目，同比增长7%。 这一趋势反映出，随着人工智能（AI）技术和新型产品发展，全球数字业务与电子产品生产基地不断扩张。半导体和电子元器件已成为相关产品的重要组成部分，进一步带动相关产业链投资和生产基地扩建。 单独来看人工智能产业链相关领域，投资促进申请共111个项目，金额超过12000亿泰铢，涵盖数据中心、数据托管、云服务、芯片设计、半导体及集成电路制造或测试、电子元器件、印刷电路板（PCB）、光子产品（Photonics），例如光纤、光学元器件及模块，以及电源供应与转换设备、AI服务器、硬盘驱动器（HDD）及相关零部件。 随着AI和数据中心产业发展，服务器、数据存储设备、高速数据传输设备、电源供应系统及散热系统等配套设备和系统的需求不断增长。这为相关设备制造商赴泰投资创造了吸引力，也为泰国本土企业参与零部件生产、系统安装和维护服务提供了机会。相关投资有助于将数据中心投资与泰国电子产业基础相衔接，并带动整个供应链相关企业创造收入。 与此同时，农业和食品产业的投资促进申请金额为801.9亿泰铢，涉及218个项目，同比增长59%。相关项目涵盖采用先进技术生产食品和饮料、动物饲料、加工淀粉、天然原料提取物、橡胶制品，以及利用农产品或农业废弃物生产的产品和包装。 上述投资方向与世界银行的判断一致。世界银行认为，数字服务、先进制造、农业和食品产业具有推动泰国经济增长、创造优质就业岗位的潜力。这也体现出泰国正推动传统产业与新兴产业协调发展：一方面巩固农业和食品等传统产业基础，另一方面培育数字产业、AI、半导体、高端电子产品、电动汽车、航空零部件、自动化和机器人等新兴产业。 能源及基础公用事业是另一重要领域，投资促进申请项目数量居各产业之首，共313个项目，投资金额598.7亿泰铢。项目涉及能源投资，尤其是太阳能、风能、生物质能和沼气等可再生能源发电，以及工业园区、工业用水生产等工业必需的公用事业设施。 这类投资对于提升泰国制造业基础
title_cn: 泰国投资促进热潮：九个月吸金1.7万亿泰铢，数字产业投资翻倍增长
summary_cn: 泰国投资促进委员会报告，2026年1至9月共收到1954项投资申请，总额17074.3亿泰铢，同比增长28%。数字产业投资最高，超11700亿泰铢（139项），涉及AI数据中心、芯片设计、半导体等领域；电子电器产业次之，投资额1893.7亿泰铢。农业食品投资增59%，投资总额801.9亿泰铢。这一增长反映全球投资向泰国转移，得益于政府「Thailand FastPass」加速机制和「Skill Bridge」人才培养计划的支持。
desc_original: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰媒报道，10月26日，泰国投资促进委员会（BOI）秘书长纳立表示，在地缘政治压力和技术发展推动全球投资格局调整的背景下，泰国投资促进申请金额持续增长，主要动力来自数字产业、电子产业以及农业和食品产业。 2026年1月至9月，泰国共收到1954个投资促进申请项目，申请投资总额达17074.3亿泰铢，同比增长28%。这一增长反映出投资向泰国转移的势头，以及投资者对泰国改善监管制度、完善基础设施和加快投资审批机制的信心。泰国政府推出的“Thailand FastPass”投资加速机制，以及面向未来产业人才培养的“Skill Bridge”措施，也为投资增长提供了支持。 其中，数字产业投资促进申请金额最高，超过11700亿泰铢，涉及139个项目，较去年同期接近翻倍。其次是电子及电器产业，申请金额为1893.7亿泰铢，涉及262个项目，同比增长7%。 这一趋势反映出，随着人工智能（AI）技术和新型产品发展，全球数字业务与电子产品生产基地不断扩张。半导体和电子元器件已成为相关产品的重要组成部分，进一步带动相关产业链投资和生产基地扩建。 单独来看人工智能产业链相关领域，投资促进申请共111个项目，金额超过12000亿泰铢，涵盖数据中心、数据托管、云服务、芯片设计、半导体及集成电路制造或测试、电子元器件、印刷电路板（PCB）、光子产品（Photonics），例如光纤、光学元器件及模块，以及电源供应与转换设备、AI服务器、硬盘驱动器（HDD）及相关零部件。 随着AI和数据中心产业发展，服务器、数据存储设备、高速数据传输设备、电源供应系统及散热系统等配套设备和系统的需求不断增长。这为相关设备制造商赴泰投资创造了吸引力，也为泰国本土企业参与零部件生产、系统安装和维护服务提供了机会。相关投资有助于将数据中心投资与泰国电子产业基础相衔接，并带动整个供应链相关企业创造收入。 与此同时，农业和食品产业的投资促进申请金额为801.9亿泰铢，涉及218个项目，同比增长59%。相关项目涵盖采用先进技术生产食品和饮料、动物饲料、加工淀粉、天然原料提取物、橡胶制品，以及利用农产品或农业废弃物生产的产品和包装。 上述投资方向与世界银行的判断一致。世界银行认为，数字服务、先进制造、农业和食品产业具有推动泰国经济增长、创造优质就业岗位的潜力。这也体现出泰国正推动传统产业与新兴产业协调发展：一方面巩固农业和食品等传统产业基础，另一方面培育数字产业、AI、半导体、高端电子产品、电动汽车、航空零部件、自动化和机器人等新兴产业。 能源及基础公用事业是另一重要领域，投资促进申请项目数量居各产业之首，共313个项目，投资金额598.7亿泰铢。项目涉及能源投资，尤其是太阳能、风能、生物质能和沼气等可再生能源发电，以及工业园区、工业用水生产等工业必需的公用事业设施。 这类投资对于提升泰国制造业基础

title: Headman apologises after 11 sakura trees cut at Doi Pui as probe widens
desc: Headman apologises after 11 sakura trees cut at Doi Pui as probe widens Legacy After volunteers cut down 15 trees without permission at a popular Chiang Mai viewpoint earlier this month, the local headman apologised today, October 26, and pledged to work with villagers to protect the site. The trees included 11 Thai sakura planted by villagers near a pavilion associated with King Rama IX at Ban Hmong Doi Pui, inside Doi Suthep-Pui National Park. Police have since identified seven people suspected of involvement in the cutting. Suthep subdistrict headman Methaphan Phuchakritdapa apologised for the incident during a joint inspection of the damaged viewpoint. He said villagers remained committed to protecting the area and promised further discussions on how the community and relevant agencies should maintain the historically significant site. title: Belavia launches direct Minsk-Bangkok flights, Phuket next
desc: Belavia launches direct Minsk-Bangkok flights, Phuket next Legacy Belavia Belarusian Airlines has launched weekly direct flights between Minsk and Bangkok, with a second route to Phuket scheduled to begin on Thursday, October 29. The first scheduled service from Belarus arrived at Suvarnabhumi Airport yesterday, October 25, marking an expansion from the airline’s previous charter operations. Flight B2 799 landed at 5.05pm, where passengers and crew were welcomed by representatives from the Tourism Authority of Thailand (TAT), the airline and airport partners. The welcoming delegation was led by Suladda Sarutilavan, TAT’s Executive Director for the Europe Region, who presented commemorative souvenirs to passengers and crew. The Minsk–Bangkok route operates every Sunday using an Airbus A330-200 aircraft with 281 seats, comprising 18 business class and 263 economy class seats. Photo via TAT Flights depart Minsk at 3.10am and arrive in Bangkok at 5.05pm. The return service leaves Bangkok at 7.05pm and reaches Minsk at 1.50am the following day. All times are local. title: Don Mueang opens 927 checked bags and finds 1,122 banned items
desc: Don Mueang opens 927 checked bags and finds 1,122 banned items Legacy Don Mueang International Airport reported finding 1,122 prohibited or non-compliant items in 927 checked bags during the first seven days of Thailand’s new baggage inspection rules, which took effect on October 16. The new measures were introduced by the Civil Aviation Authority of Thailand (CAAT) and allow authorised airport security personnel to open checked baggage without the owner being present when screening raises reasonable suspicion of prohibited or potentially dangerous items. The airport’s findings covered the period from October 16 to 22. Power banks, lighters, electronic cigarettes and other battery-powered devices were among the items identified during inspections. Photo via Facebook/ Suvarnabhumi Airport Under the new procedures, security officers must record the inspection on video and place a Notice of Baggage Inspection inside any bag they open. The notice informs the owner that the luggage has been searched. title: Wildlife photographer encounters rare group of big cats at national park
desc: Wildlife photographer encounters rare group of big cats at national park Legacy A wildlife photographer spotted five young leopards , including two black panthers, together in Kaeng Krachan National Park in Phetchaburi yesterday, October 25, in a rare wildlife encounter. The animals were seen between 9am and 10am along the road to Ban Krang campsite, near the Khao Sam Yot ranger station. Park Chief Mongkol Chaipakdee said freelance wildlife photographer Natnalee Suraplanan managed to photograph and film a female black panther and a male spotted leopard. The other three animals, comprising another black panther and two spotted leopards, quickly disappeared into roadside bushes before she could capture them on camera. Black panthers are not a separate species but leopards with a dark coat caused by melanism. Photo via Department of National Parks Based on their appearance and behaviour, Mongkol believes the five animals are siblings from the same litter, approximately two to three years old. title: 泰国罗勇府查扣一大型电子垃圾仓库，囤积废料达万吨
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰国媒体报道，10月25日，泰国自然资源与环境部部长素查指派部长顾问伊提蓬警中将带领特别行动组，前往罗勇府Nikhom Pattana县Nikhom Pattana镇1村，对罗勇工业有限公司的出租仓库进行检查，以扩大调查该区域无证经营工厂和可疑工业废料囤积的问题。据悉，该区域面积约90莱，有15栋仓库出租，执法人员在10月12日的检查中发现，该区域内有工厂无证从事金属废料、电线、电子电器部件及其他废料分拣，数量达1万吨左右。 伊提蓬警中将表示，素查高度关注民众健康和当地污染的问题，因此要求特别行动组仔细核查。在初步检查中，行动组已收集电子部件碎片和需进一步查验的材料，待逐栋检查完毕后，再汇总证据、总结结果。另外，行动组还将追查材料来源、运输路线、分拣与回收过程以及剩余废料的处理方式，确认这些电子垃圾是否是从国外进口的，一旦确定违法，将依法追究相关人员责任。 上周，当地反有毒垃圾组织和受到恶臭空气影响的居民接连投诉罗勇工业有限公司的出租仓库，指其无证从事电子电器部件分拣、粉碎，并堆放大量危险原料。罗勇府工业办和有关部门介入调查后，并已下令关闭工厂、查封全部机器设备和物品，以进一步深入调查。 此前，有中资企业曾用大编织袋装载工业废料，用拖车从Nikhom Pattana县的仓库运往春武里府Ban Bueng县Khlong Kiw镇工业区，执法人员已在Khlong Kiw镇4村某仓库查扣了300多个装有工业废料的大编织袋，总重量约300吨。在之后扩大调查罗勇工业有限公司的出租仓库时，执法人员缴获大量电子垃圾，并下令关闭工厂继续核实事实。罗勇府工业办最新消息显示，已对罗勇工业有限公司立案处理，包括指控其涉嫌无证持有危险物品和机器设备，以及要求其通知工厂对不合规部分进行整改。 （编译：KA；来源：dailynews） The post 泰国罗勇府查扣一大型电子垃圾仓库，囤积废料达万吨 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 10月25日，泰国民航局（CAAT）公布了《2026年航空托运行李检查规定》的执行情况。总体跟踪结果显示，新规落地顺利，查获的违禁物品主要是充电宝和带电池的电子设备，这些物品如果存放或运输不当，可能会带来安全风险，尤其是短路和货舱起火等。据悉，《2026年航空托运行李检查规定》自10月16日起生效，对于X光机检测发现的可疑物品，机场指定的工作人员有权在乘客不在场的情况下开箱检查托运行李。 CAAT强调，开箱检查托运行李的目的是防止违禁物品或可能造成危险的物品被带上飞机，并非对所有行李普遍开箱。检查流程从X光机筛查开始，仅在发现可疑物品时，工作人员才会将行李移至指定区域，由依法指定的人员开箱检查，全程录像留存证据，以便事后追溯，同时也会在行李内放置《行李检查通知书》，让行李主人知情。 超出规定步骤、区域或由未获授权人员开箱行李的行为，不属于新规定的范围，且可能构成违法。托运行李在整个行程中由航空公司负责运输，乘客若发现行李或内部物品异常，可直接联系所乘航空公司，并要求相关部门共同核实事实。 针对社交媒体上传播的4起乘客行李被开箱的案例，CAAT已与相关部门核实，其中2起是从泰国飞往国外的航班，机场闭路电视确认，并非机场安检人员的开箱检查；另1起是从国外飞入泰国的航班，出发前检查属始发地机场的规定，与泰国无关；再有1起是国内航班，确实属于按新规定的开箱检查，因为其箱内有带电池的电子设备，由于该行李箱非使用TSA锁，工作人员不得不剪开拉链开箱检查，并按规定放入检查通知书。 为保障顺利出行、减少问题，CAAT建议乘客每次整理行李前，通过航空公司官方网站核对违禁物品清单和行李运输条件，尤其是充电宝，绝对禁止放入托运行李。另外，还应核对带电池电子设备和其他物品的运输限制，因为不同公司的规定可能有差异，以此降低安全风险并减少额外开箱需要。 乘客在合上行李前可以拍摄内部物品照片、在办理登机手续时拍摄行李外观照片留存，尽量避免将贵重物品放入托运行李，以便在行李或内部物品损坏、丢失或延误时，方便与航空公司核查和协调。CAAT重申，执行《2026年航空托运行李检查规定》的目的是保障乘客和航空器安全，《规定》中明确了操作步骤和事后追溯措施，CAAT也将持续跟踪执行情况，向公众普及相关知识，确保航空旅行安全，增强民众对泰国民航安全体系的信心。 （编译：KA；） The post 泰国民航局强调开箱检查按规执行，乘客可留存照片追溯 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
title_cn: 泰国民航局强调行李开箱检查规范执行，乘客可留存证据追溯
summary_cn: 泰国民航局公布新版行李检查规定执行情况。自10月16日生效，仅在X光机发现可疑物品时才由授权人员开箱检查，全程录像备查。违禁品主要为充电宝和带电池电子设备，易构成安全隐患。民航局建议乘客登机前拍照记录行李内容和外观，避免放入禁品，选用TSA锁便于检查。规范执行旨在确保航空安全并保护乘客权益。
